title: Modular Insights launch readiness: coordinated release notes, training, and cross-team comms
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket coordinates the launch readiness activities for Modular Insights (a set of composable dashboards and a new cost-explainability panel). Scope includes finalizing release notes, aligning cross-functional training for Support/Solutions/AMs, staging comms for customer-facing channels, and validating in-console copy and telemetry hooks before GA.

Objectives:
- Produce a single-source-of-truth release notes artifact and short customer-facing summary.
- Run two internal training sessions and prepare an on-demand snippet library (videos + one-pagers).
- Coordinate engineering and design sign-offs on UI copy, rollout gating, and metrics collection.
- Publish console activation gates and rollback steps to the Operations runbook.

Progress updates:
- 2026-01-22: Draft release notes created in Confluence (link below). Added feature bullets, limitations, and known issues.
- 2026-01-25: Design review (Elena Kim) completed — requested copy tweaks for the cost explainability modal to reduce legal risk around phrasing. Action: PM to update copy and confirm with Legal.
- 2026-01-28: Eng review (Ravi Singh) flagged an event-mismatch for token_cost_breakdown telemetry. Engineering to provide a small PR that updates instrumented event names.
- 2026-01-30: Field readiness sync — Support and Solutions requested two short FAQs about expected false-positive explanations and guidance for customers to report anomalies.
- 2026-02-02: Release-note draft version 1.3 approved by Product Lead (Aisha Patel). Training dates confirmed for 2026-02-08 and 2026-02-09.

Decisions and trade-offs:
- Rollout model: decided on a staged activation by customer tier (Beta -> Dedicated customers -> GA) to protect SLAs for high-throughput Dedicated pools. Rationale: reducing blast radius while gathering live telemetry.
- Copy vs. speed trade-off: simplified explanation text chosen over a longer, more technically accurate version to reduce cognitive load during first exposure. Follow-up: longer technical note to be posted in Developer Docs.
- Telemetry completeness vs. privacy: opted not to log full prompt text in early rollout. Instead we will collect aggregated diagnostic metrics and sampled anonymized prompts under a stricter retention policy.

Open items and blockers:
- Legal approval on wording for the Cost Explainability panel is outstanding (due 2026-02-04). Blocker for final UI copy.
- Engineering PR for telemetry event names needs review and merge (PR #1742). Deployment blocked until merged.
- Localization: need localization estimate for seven languages (i18n team to provide by 2026-02-05).

Review feedback and approvals:
- Design (Elena Kim): approved visual layout; requested one copy tweak and accessibility check for color contrast.
- Engineering (Ravi Singh): requested minor schema change; engineering committed to a patch in the next sprint.
- Field (Marta Lopez - Support): requested two one-pager troubleshooting flows; PM to coordinate content owners.

Activation plan and schedule:
- 2026-02-08: Internal training session #1 (Support + Solutions) — live Q&A.
- 2026-02-09: Internal training session #2 (Sales + Customer Success) — focus on positioning and objection handling.
- 2026-02-10: Soft activation to Beta customers (10% of signups). Monitor latency and error budget for 48h.
- 2026-02-12: Expand to Dedicated customers (gated) if metrics pass.
- 2026-02-19: GA to all customers with full release notes and product blog post (dependent on Beta/Dedicated pass).

Telemetry & success metrics to monitor during rollout:
- Error rate for the cost-explainability flow (target < 0.5% of sessions).
- Average tokenization latency impact (target < +8ms p50).
- Adoption: percentage of dashboard users who open the Cost Explainability panel within 14 days (target 12%).
- Support volume: number of tickets referencing "cost explanation" in first 14 days (target < 1% of active customers).

Rollback criteria and runbook steps:
- Immediate rollback if error rate > 3% sustained for 30 minutes or if p99 latency increases by > 60ms for two consecutive 15-minute windows.
- Runbook: revert feature flag -> backfill missing telemetry -> open incident bridge -> notify customer success + engineering on-call. Full rollback steps in Operations runbook link below.

Post-launch follow-up items (owner):
- Postmortem + lessons learned (Carlos Mendes) — due 2026-02-26.
- Create a technical appendix for Developers (Ravi Singh) — due 2026-02-16.
- Localization rollout plan and timeline (i18n team) — due 2026-02-05.
- Field enablement FAQ bundle (Marta Lopez + Carlos Mendes) — due 2026-02-07.

Dependencies:
- ENG-8921 (telemetry schema change)
- ENG-9012 (feature flagging infra for staged rollout)
- PM-65900 (developer docs cross-publish)

Customer impact: medium
Security_review_required: false

Notes and context for reviewers:
- Keep the customer summary concise and action-oriented; the target audience is engineering and product leads at customer organizations.
- Emphasize the staged gating approach in all comms to set expectations for availability.
- For the training sessions, we will record and produce three 3-5 minute explainer clips for embed in the Console Help center.
